Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Kshitij Shailendra,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned Standing Counsel for the State-respondents no.2 and 3 and Sri Pranjal Mehrotra for respondents no.1 and 4.
2.

The petitioners have prayed for a direction to the respondent authorities to pay enhanced compensation to them for having acquired their land comprising of Khasra No.67, area 0.0168 hectare, situated at Village Andawa, Pargana Kara, Tehsil Sirathu, District Kaushambi and to decide representation dated 23.04.2024 made in this behalf.

sentences.text: Indisputably, the petitioners have received compensation in lieu of acquisition of their land in pursuance of award of the Competent Authority made under the provisions of the National Highways Act, 1956.
In case they are not satisfied with the award, it is open to them to challenge the same in the manner provided under the National Highways Act, 1956.
4. No good ground is made out to issue any direction in exercise of writ jurisdiction for payment of higher compensation or for deciding the representation.
5. The petition stands disposed of with the aforesaid liberty to the petitioners.
